meta.name: cantera
meta.description: Runs Cantera homogeneous chemical reactors and evaluates ignition delay with mechanism provenance, conservation checks, and numerical refinement. Use for combustion kinetics, closed adiabatic ideal-gas constant-volume or constant-pressure ignition, temperature histories, or mechanism-specific ignition-delay comparisons.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑燃烧反应模拟,算出点火延迟并核对机理来源与守恒
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果研究燃烧化学动力学,需要对比不同机理下的点火延迟
copy.tagline_en: Simulate combustion reactors and compare ignition delays across mechanisms
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you study combustion chemistry and need mechanism-based ignition delay results

howto.what: 装好后 Claude 能跑 Cantera 均相反应器模拟:给定机理、初温、压力和摩尔组成,计算定容或定压点火延迟,并做守恒检查与网格、求解器细化,产出报告和四条温度等历史曲线。
howto.when: 当你要求做燃烧动力学、闭式绝热定容或定压点火、不同机理的点火延迟比较等计算时接管;它不是火焰求解器,也不是通用反应器网络工具。

say.text: 用 h2o2.yaml 的氢氧氩定容算例跑一次点火延迟
say.note: 会输出延迟值和四份历史 CSV

say.text: 把算例换成我自己的机理 YAML,重算点火延迟
say.note: 自定义机理需是 Cantera YAML

say.text: 报告里给我这次用的机理哈希和延迟定义
say.note: 报告还含守恒与细化检查结果

howto.what_en: Claude runs Cantera closed ideal-gas reactors: from a mechanism, temperature, pressure and mole composition it computes constant-volume or constant-pressure ignition delay, adds conservation checks and refinement, writes a report plus CSVs.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask for combustion kinetics, closed adiabatic constant-volume or constant-pressure ignition, or mechanism-specific ignition-delay comparisons; it is not a flame solver or network builder.

say_en.text: Run the hydrogen/oxygen/argon constant-volume example with h2o2.yaml
say_en.note: Outputs the delay and four history CSVs.

say_en.text: Recalculate the ignition delay with my own mechanism YAML
say_en.note: Custom mechanisms must be Cantera YAML files.

say_en.text: Show the mechanism hash and delay definition in the report
say_en.note: Report also lists conservation and refinement checks.
